subtasks: Pick up two slices of bread, place them into the toaster, and press the lever down.
Pick up the raised bread slice from the rack and place it upright in one empty toaster slot.
Place one more upright slice from the bread rack into the empty right toaster slot while leaving the first slice in place.
Straighten the tilted slice already in the left toaster slot and seat it fully upright in that slot.
Place one upright slice from the rack into the empty right toaster slot, without disturbing the slice resting in the left slot.

Recover the loose second bread slice lying across the top of the rack, and insert it upright into the empty right toaster slot. Leave the two supported rack slices and the first toaster slice in place.
